title: You Need to Read Again: Multi-granularity Perception Network for Moment Retrieval in Videos

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Previous methods tend to perform self-modal learning and cross-modal interaction in a coarse manner, which neglect fine-grained clues contained in video content, query context, and their alignment.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: For the drawbacks mentioned above, we apply a coarse-to-fine strategy to mine intra-modality and inter-modality information at a multi-granularity level.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Upper: Existing works tend to encode intra-modality and inter-modality information in a coarse-grained manner (with one-step reasoning), which may neglect semantic details (e.g. "left" hand) and lead to misalignment.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: Existing works for this task generally fall into two categories: two-stage models [1, 8, 41] and one-stage models [20, 46, 49].
